name: Daisy Dream Eau de Toilette
editorialDescription: A fruity floral eau de toilette in the Daisy family, in a pale-blue bottle with a daisy-covered cap. Retailer copy for the fragrance lists blackberry, grapefruit and pear on top, jasmine, lychee and blue wisteria in the heart, and white woods, musk and coconut water in the base — an airier, more watery take on the Daisy idea than the original.
keyFeatures: Top notes: blackberry, grapefruit, pear (per Ulta's listing)
Heart notes: jasmine, lychee, blue wisteria
Base notes: white woods, musk, coconut water
advantages: A published note pyramid makes it easy to compare with the rest of the Daisy line
Sold in several sizes at major retailers, so you can usually find a smaller bottle or mini to try first
disadvantages: Eau de toilette labels aren't standardized, so don't assume a particular strength or wear time
Fragrance ingredients are listed only as "fragrance" on U.S. labels, which makes it hard to screen for a known allergen
suits: People who like fresh, fruity florals over heavier or sweeter scents
Anyone choosing between Daisy flankers who prefers a lighter, watery feel
skipIf: You react to fragranced products or have fragrance allergy; FDA notes fragrance ingredients may be listed only as "fragrance" on U.S. labels
You want to smell it on your own skin before committing to a full bottle; look for a travel spray, mini or sample first
buyingConsiderations: Check the listing says Daisy Dream (not Daisy, Daisy Love or Daisy Dream Forever) and eau de toilette
Check bottle size; listings often offer several
Buy from a listing sold by the brand or Amazon to reduce the risk of counterfeit or old stock
